http://developer.android.com/reference/android/Manifest.permission.html#READ_LOGS

This was a similar issue with the CarrierIQ thing. Apps have to explicitly request this permission, and it's a strange one that should raise red flags unless it is explicitly intended for such a purpose.

Indeed, the app that the author links to - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nolanlawson.logcat&hl=en  - under permission there's the READ SYSTEM LOGS.

Sadly a ridiculous number of apps demand it for questionable reasons (for instance https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sirma.mobile.bible.android -> Why does a Bible need to read from system logs?)
